title: My Strength Journey — No Equipment
description: Personal beginner strength plan that complements weight-gain meals; three strength days plus recovery.

userDefaults.note: Recently reported unintended weight loss; seek medical assessment before vigorous training.

settings.warmup: 3–5 minutes of gentle movement before strength sessions
settings.cooldown: 2–3 minutes of gentle movement after sessions
settings.progression: Begin with comfortable sets. After two sessions of good technique, increase reps slightly within the range. Add a set only later if recovery and eating are adequate.
settings.stopWarning: Stop for chest pain, dizziness, faintness, or unusual breathlessness and seek medical advice.
settings.nutritionReminder: Keep eating regular meals and snacks; workouts should not replace meals.

exerciseLibrary.name: Bodyweight squat
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Stand with feet roughly shoulder-width apart. Bend hips and knees, lower comfortably while keeping feet grounded, then stand tall.
exerciseLibrary.formCue: Keep knees following toes; use a stable chair as a depth target if needed.
exerciseLibrary.caution: Avoid forcing depth or rounding painfully through your back.

exerciseLibrary.name: Incline push-up
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Place hands on a stable counter or wall, keep body in a straight line, bend elbows to lower chest, then press away.
exerciseLibrary.formCue: Choose a higher surface to make it easier.

exerciseLibrary.name: Floor push-up
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders; keep torso braced, lower under control and push back up.
exerciseLibrary.formCue: Use incline version when form breaks down.

exerciseLibrary.name: Supported reverse lunge
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Hold a stable support if needed, step backward, bend both knees comfortably, press through front foot to return.

exerciseLibrary.name: Glute bridge
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Lie on back with knees bent and feet planted. Tighten glutes to lift hips, pause, lower slowly.
exerciseLibrary.formCue: Keep ribs relaxed and avoid excessive lower-back arching.

exerciseLibrary.name: Standing calf raise
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Hold a stable support, lift heels slowly and lower with control.

exerciseLibrary.name: Forearm plank
exerciseLibrary.restBetweenSets: Place forearms under shoulders and brace body from head to heels; breathe steadily.
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Shorter holds with quality form beat longer holds.

exerciseLibrary.name: Bird-dog
exerciseLibrary.instructions: On hands and knees, slowly extend opposite arm and leg, pause and return; alternate sides.
exerciseLibrary.formCue: Keep hips level and movement controlled.

exerciseLibrary.name: Dead bug
exerciseLibrary.instructions: On back with arms up and knees bent, lower opposite arm and leg gradually while keeping trunk stable.
exerciseLibrary.formCue: Use a smaller range as needed.

exerciseLibrary.name: Prone reverse snow angel
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Lie face down, lift hands slightly and sweep arms gently from sides toward overhead within a pain-free range.

exerciseLibrary.name: Bent-knee side plank
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Lie on side supported by forearm and bent knees; lift hips and hold while breathing.

exerciseLibrary.name: Wall sit
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Lean against a wall and slide into a comfortable partial squat, then stand.
exerciseLibrary.formCue: Choose a shallow knee angle at first.

exerciseLibrary.name: Cat-cow mobility
exerciseLibrary.instructions: On hands and knees, gently alternate spinal rounding and extension, breathing normally.

exerciseLibrary.name: Hip mobility flow
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Perform gentle standing hip circles and controlled leg swings with support.

exerciseLibrary.name: Shoulder mobility flow
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Perform gentle shoulder rolls and controlled arm circles.

exerciseLibrary.name: Comfortable walk
exerciseLibrary.instructions: Walk at a conversational pace, adjusting duration to energy level.
exerciseLibrary.formCue: Keep it easy on recovery days.
exerciseLibrary.caution: Stop for dizziness or unusual symptoms.

mediaCoverage.rule: Never show squat GIF for another exercise. Display accurate written instructions until each specific exercise media asset is created and reviewed.
